text:
OncallBot: :rotating_light: Pager P2 - canary/error-surge in us-east-prod on inference path. 5xx->429 spike, affecting low-latency routes. Alert: rollup error rate 12% (baseline 0.5%). link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/2060007777

Priya Gandhi: I'm oncall and seeing the same in dashboards. Starting investigation.

Alex Chen: Observed token-bucket saturation on provider 'falcon' pods in us-east. CPU and queue depth high, KV cache misses spiking. First seen ~03:12 UTC.

Samir Patel: Any recent deploys to routing or model configs? DeployBot: deploy 2034.5 rolled 02:58 UTC to traffic-router (no obvious errors).

Priya Gandhi: Noted a slow steady increase after that deploy window. I'm checking request traces and headers now.

Alex Chen: Traces show long tail on /v1/generate-reorder for non-prem customers. Large prompt sizes from a few tenants causing backpressure -> 429s cascading.

Marta Reyes: Could be a noisy tenant hitting reranked endpoints with long context + high concurrency. Would suggest partial brownout of non-critical rerank route while we triage.

Priya Gandhi: Agreed. Plan proposal: 1) soft quota for noisy tenants (limit concurrency to 2), 2) route a portion of traffic off 'falcon' to 'zenith' provider, 3) disable non-prem reorder endpoint for 10m canary. Comments?

Samir Patel: +1. Need to coordinate with traffic-router and edge-shaper. I can execute provider weight shift.

Alex Chen: I'll prepare the toggle for non-prem reorder (feature-gate). Where do we announce to customers? We'll need status page blurb if >10% impacted.

Priya Gandhi: InfraBot, snapshot current routing weights and provider health?

InfraBot: Current weights (us-east): {"falcon":0.7, "zenith":0.3}. Falcon health: degraded (latency p95 up 3x, error rate 9%). Zenith health: nominal.

Samir Patel: Executing incremental reroute now: shifting weights to falcon:0.4 zenith:0.6 over 3 steps to avoid oscillation. Command: ```
curl -X POST https://traffic-router.internal/admin/weights -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"region":"us-east","weights":{"falcon":0.4,"zenith":0.6}}'
```

Priya Gandhi: Applying non-prem reorder brownout (canary 1/3). Toggle command: ```
redwoodctl feature toggle --env=prod --region=us-east --feature=non_premium_reorder --state=off --scope=canary:33%
```

DeployBot: feature toggle request accepted. Rollout started.

Alex Chen: I'm also pushing a temporary per-tenant concurrency soft-cap in the edge-proxy for large payloads: ```
PATCH /edge-config/v1/quotas
{
  "rule": "if route == \"/v1/generate-reorder\" and tenant_tier != \"premium\" then concurrency_limit = 2"
}
```

Samir Patel: Shifts in place. Monitoring metrics. Early signs: error rate dropping from 12% -> 6% in 2m. Latency tail reducing.

Priya Gandhi: Good. Let's keep the canary for 10 minutes and watch for regression. If stable, continue rollout to 100% for non-prem reorder disabled and keep provider split at 0.4/0.6 for 30m while CI evaluates.

Marta Reyes: Also recommend enabling additional request sampling for trace ids to catch offending tenants and correlate with usage patterns. Priya, can you set sampling to 100% for the affected route?

Priya Gandhi: Done. Increased sampling on /v1/generate-reorder for us-east to 100% for 15m.

InfraBot: New metrics snapshot: error rate 6.2%, falcon p95 latency reduced 28%, zenith CPU +10%. No obvious new resource pressure.

Alex Chen: I see three tenants with very large median prompt lengths and high concurrency — flagged them in the internal tenant-watchlist. Reaching out to the account owners for coordination (DMs).

Samir Patel: If we need to free more capacity quick, we can shift falcon weight to 0.2 and increase zenith to 0.8, but that will increase cost. Hold for now unless we see error rate plateau >8%.

Marta Reyes: Agree. Watch for oscillation. Also check GPU temp on falcon hosts; thermal throttling could explain degradation.

Priya Gandhi: Falon hosts show normal thermals. Problem looks software-level queue grind from heavy reorders.

InfraBot: Reminder: runbook recommends graceful brownout first, then provider reroute if brownout insufficient. You're following runbook section 4.2.

Priya Gandhi: 05m into canary: error rate at 4.5%, p95 within SLO for most routes. Proceeding to expand non-prem reorder brownout to 100% for us-east (rolling).

Samir Patel: Rolling to 100% now. Command executed. Monitoring.

DeployBot: Brownout rollout completed to 100% for region us-east.

Alex Chen: Error rate now 1.1%, latency back to baseline. Good recovery. Recommendation: keep non-prem reorder brownout for 2 hours while we instrument better quotas and long-term throttles. Also plan tenant-level outreach and suggest customers use streaming chunking to reduce prompt size.

Marta Reyes: I'll draft a short postmortem noting the noisy-tenant + reorder path as root cause, and recommend guardrails: default concurrency caps for non-prem, prompt-length soft quotas, and an automated small-weight reroute when provider error rate >5%.

Priya Gandhi: Oncall handoff: I'm handing to Marta in 20m — will include runbook steps, current mitigation, and flagged tenants. Marta, do you want the handoff now?

Marta Reyes: Taking over in 20. Please include the sampling traces and the list of tenant IDs.

Priya Gandhi: Handoff notes posted to channel: runbook link, sampling link, flagged-tenants list, commands executed.

Samir Patel: Final note: kept reroute conservative to avoid capacity shock on zenith. If we see any secondary provider issue, we may need to spin more capacity or apply broader brownouts.

OncallBot: Incident status: mitigated -> partial mitigations active (non-prem reorder brownout, provider split adjusted). Incident severity downgraded to S2. Owner: Marta Reyes.

Marta Reyes: Acknowledged. I'll coordinate post-incident cleanup and customer comms. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
